system.description: Stabilizes a Mortally Wounded victim on a successful Int or Dex/Heal check against difficulty 6 plus 1 per full round since they went down. A failed attempt can be retried with a fresh patch; useless after six rounds. Cannot revive victims downed by poison, explosives, or other massive trauma. Unlike most stims, this is bulky and counts as one item of Encumbrance.
